response.sql: SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) as avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.amount >= 2400 AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC LIMIT 10

alternatives.interpretation: The average balance could include all transactions with amount ≥ 2400 (regardless of type), while the average signed amount only includes PRIJEM and VYDAJ, if 'after those transactions' refers to all filtered transactions rather than only those with signed amounts.
